AbilityRule.description:
One rule of the signed-in user's abilities, as CASL's `createMongoAbility` takes it
(`GET /api/me/abilities` answers with a list of them).

conditions.description: Conditions on the record's fields, in the MongoDB query language.

inverted.description:
Whether the rule takes the ability away (`cannot`). Left out, never null, when it
doesn't.

reason.description:
Why the rule exists, for the message of a refusal. Left out, never null, when
there is none.

Activity.description:
An activity as the API returns it:
`{__type: "Activity", id, kind, subject, body, due_at, completed_at,
subject_type, subject_id, subject_label, owner_id, owner, assignee_id,
assignee, created_at}`.

assignee_id.description: The user who should do it.

subject_id.description: The record it is attached to.

subject_label.description:
That record's name: the company's name, the contact's full name or
the deal's title.

subject_type.description: The kind of record it is attached to.

assignee_id.description: Who should do it (an existing user).

due_at.description: When it is due (RFC 3339; stored in UTC).

subject_id.description: The record it is attached to (must exist).

subject_type.description: The kind of record it is attached to.

ActivityKind.description:
What an activity records (`activities.kind`); only tasks have due
dates that matter and can be completed.

ActivityPage.description:
A page of activities as `GET /api/v1/activities` returns it (the
OpenAPI schema of a `Page<ActivityResource>`): `{data, meta}`.

meta.description:
The pagination metadata of an [`ActivityPage`] (inlined in the schema,
so no `PageMeta` component of this crate can clash with another's).

ActivitySubjectType.description:
The kind of record an activity is attached to
(`activities.subject_type`).

ActivityUpdateInput.description:
The body of `PATCH /api/v1/activities/{id}`: only the fields present
change. `body`, `due_at` and `assignee_id` are cleared with `null`; the
other fields cannot be `null`.

assignee_id.description: Who should do it; `null` unassigns it.

due_at.description: When it is due; `null` clears it.

subject_id.description: The record it is attached to (must exist).

subject_type.description: The kind of record it is attached to.

AuditPage.description: A page of audit entries, newest first.

AuthMessage.description: A response carrying a human-readable message.

BoardStage.description: One column of the board: a stage with its deals in board order.

probability.description: Its chance of winning, in percent.

Company.description:
A company as the API returns it (schema `Company`):
`{__type: "Company", id, name, domain, industry, size, phone, website,
city, country, owner_id, owner: {id, name}, created_at, updated_at}`.

__type.description: The CASL subject type of a [`CompanyResource`] (`"Company"`).

contacts_count.description: Contacts at the company (deleted ones left out).

open_deals_amount_cents.description: The sum of the open deals' `amount_cents`, across currencies.

CompanyDetail.description:
`GET /api/v1/companies/{id}`: the company plus its live contacts and
open (not won or lost) deals.

CompanyInput.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/companies`. Text fields are trimmed; blank
optional fields are stored as `null`.

owner_id.description:
The owner (default: the caller). Only users who can manage companies
may name someone else (403 otherwise).

CompanyPage.description: A page of companies: `{data: Company[], meta}`.

meta.description: The pagination metadata of a page, as documented (`meta`).

CompanyRef.description: A company as embedded in a contact or deal.

CompanyUpdateInput.description:
The body of `PATCH /api/v1/companies/{id}`: only the fields sent
change; `null` (or a blank string) clears an optional field.

owner_id.description: The new owner: managers and admins only (403 otherwise).

ConfirmInput.description:
`POST /auth/confirm`: the password or a code from the authenticator
app (exactly one).

code.description: A current code from the authenticator app.
A current code from the authenticator app.

ConfirmedToken.description:
What `POST /auth/confirm` returns: a new access token for the same
session with `auth_time` set to now.

auth_time.description: When the user confirmed (Unix seconds; the token's `auth_time`).

Contact.description:
A contact as the API returns it (schema `Contact`):
`{__type: "Contact", id, first_name, last_name, full_name, email, phone,
title, status, company_id, company: {id, name} | null, owner_id,
owner: {id, name}, created_at, updated_at}`.

__type.description: The CASL subject type of a [`ContactResource`] (`"Contact"`).

ContactInput.description:
The body of `POST /api/v1/contacts`. Text fields are trimmed; blank
optional fields are stored as `null`.

company_id.description: The company they work at (must exist and not be deleted).

owner_id.description:
The owner (default: the caller). Only users who can manage contacts
may name someone else (403 otherwise).

ContactPage.description: A page of contacts: `{data: Contact[], meta}`.

meta.description: The pagination metadata of a page, as documented (`meta`).

ContactRef.description: A contact as embedded in a deal.

ContactStatus.description: Where a contact is in the customer life cycle (`contacts.status`).

ContactUpdateInput.description:
The body of `PATCH /api/v1/contacts/{id}`: only the fields sent change;
`null` (or a blank string) clears an optional field.

owner_id.description: The new owner: managers and admins only (403 otherwise).

recent_activities.description: The ten newest activities, newest first.

DashboardDealTotals.description: A number of deals and their amounts.

weighted_amount_cents.description: Their amounts weighted by their stages' probabilities, rounded down.

count.description: How many deals are in it.

DashboardTaskCounts.description: Open tasks by due date (UTC days).

Deal.description:
A deal as the API returns it: the row plus
`probability` (from the stage) and the `company`, `contact` and `owner`
embeds.

amount_cents.description: The value in the currency's minor unit (cents).

closed_at.description: When it was won or lost; `null` while open.

expected_close_date.description: When the deal is expected to close (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

position.description: The 0-based place within the stage's column on the board.

probability.description: The chance of winning, in percent (from the stage).

amount_cents.description: The value in cents, from 0 to [`MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS`].

lost_reason.description: Why the deal was lost: required when `stage` is `lost`.

owner_id.description:
The owner (default: the signed-in user; someone else needs
`manage` on deals).

lost_reason.description: Why the deal was lost: required when `stage` is `lost`.

position.description:
The 0-based index within the target stage (default: the end;
larger values mean the end); the other deals there shift.

DealPage.description: A page of deals (the OpenAPI shape of `GET /api/v1/deals`).

allOf.description: The pagination metadata (`navree::db::PageMeta`), for the documentation.

DealStage.description:
A deal's pipeline stage (`deals.stage`), in board order; new deals
start as `lead`.

DealUpdateInput.description:
The body of `PATCH /api/v1/deals/{id}`: only the fields present
change; `contact_id` and `expected_close_date` may be `null` to clear
them.

amount_cents.description: The value in cents, from 0 to [`MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS`].

lost_reason.description: Why the deal was lost: required when it becomes `lost`.

oneOf.description:
A new stage: the deal moves to the end of that column (needs `move`
on the deal).

email.description: The email address of the account.

HttpError.description: The JSON error shape every error response carries (`application/json`).

code.description: The machine-readable error code (`not_found`, `validation_failed`, `invalid_credentials`), stable across releases, for front ends to map to a translation key. Left out when `http.errors.code` is false.

error.description: The reason phrase of the status (`Not Found`, `Bad Request`).

errors.description: Validation messages per field (400 validation errors only).

message.description: What went wrong: one message, or every validation message.

LoginResponse.description: The login and register response: the user and a token pair.

LoginResult.description:
The documented `POST /auth/login` response (OpenAPI `oneOf`): the user
and tokens, or a [`TwoFactorChallenge`] for accounts with two-factor
authentication, so generated clients see both shapes.

oneOf.description:
Signed in. (The handler renders this through [`signed_in`], which
adds the user resource's extension fields.)

LogoutInput.description: `POST /auth/logout` (an optional body). `Debug` never shows the token.

all.description: End every session of the user.

refresh_token.description: The session to end (its refresh token).

NewPushSubscription.description: A browser push subscription, as `PushSubscription.toJSON()` gives it.

Notification.description: A notification stored by the database channel.

NotificationPage.description: A page of notifications, newest first.

NotificationPreferences.description: Notification preferences with the workspace's defaults and the effective value of each category.

data.description: Notification preferences: every field is optional and inherited when left out.

channels.description: Channel switches (mail, database, slack, teams, sms, whatsapp, web_push).

anyOf.description: Notification preferences: every field is optional and inherited when left out.

Channel switches (mail, database, slack, teams, sms, whatsapp, web_push).

NotificationPreferencesPatch.description: A JSON merge patch of the preferences: objects merge, null removes a choice.

channels.description: Channel switches (mail, database, slack, teams, sms, whatsapp, web_push).
Channel switches (mail, database, slack, teams, sms, whatsapp, web_push).

note.description: What the operation is doing, for people.

percent.description: `done` as a whole percentage of `total` (0 when `total` is 0).

OperationRecord.description:
A stored operation: what [`Operations`] returns, `GET
/api/operations/{id}` answers, the SSE stream sends and
`operation.updated` broadcasts.

heartbeat_at.description: When its work last showed signs of life.

OwnerRef.description: A user as embedded in a record (`owner`, `assignee`).

recovery_codes.description: Single-use codes that replace an authenticator code at login.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token of the last token pair.

email.description: The email address of the account.

token.description: The token from the reset mail.

Role.description:
A CRM role, as `POST /api/v1/users` and `PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}` take
it (`"admin" | "manager" | "rep"`).

data.description: The sessions, most recently used first.

SessionResource.description:
One of the user's sessions (a refresh-token family), as `GET
/auth/sessions` lists it.

authenticated_at.description: When the user last authenticated in it (signing in or confirming).

current.description: Whether the request was made with it.

device.description:
A short description of the device, from the user agent
(`"Firefox on Windows"`).

impersonator_id.description: For an impersonation session: the impersonating user.

ip.description: The client IP address of its last sign-in or refresh.

last_used_at.description: When it was last used (its last sign-in or refresh).

platform.description: Whether it is a platform session.

user_agent.description: The client's `User-Agent` at its last sign-in or refresh.

TokenPair.description:
An access token and a refresh token, as returned by the login, register
and refresh routes:
`{"access_token", "refresh_token", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_in"}`,
plus `"two_factor_setup_required": true` when the user must set up
two-factor authentication before the session reaches anything but the
setup routes.

expires_in.description: The access token's lifetime in seconds.

refresh_token.description: The opaque refresh token (`POST /auth/refresh`); single use.

two_factor_setup_required.description:
Whether the access token is limited to setting up two-factor
authentication (`POST /auth/2fa/enable`, `POST /auth/2fa/confirm`,
then `POST /auth/refresh` for a full token). Omitted when false.

TwoFactorChallenge.description:
The login response of an account with two-factor authentication:
`{"two_factor_required": true, "challenge_token", "expires_in"}`.

challenge_token.description: The challenge token for `POST /auth/2fa/verify` (not an access token).

expires_in.description: The challenge token's lifetime in seconds.

TwoFactorSetup.description:
What `POST /auth/2fa/enable` returns: the new TOTP secret for the
user's authenticator app. Two-factor authentication is active once the
user confirms a code from it (`POST /auth/2fa/confirm`).

qr_svg.description: The URL as a QR code, an SVG document.

TwoFactorVerifyInput.description:
`POST /auth/2fa/verify`: the challenge token of the login and either a
code from the authenticator app or a recovery code.

code.description: A current code from the authenticator app.

recovery_code.description: One of the recovery codes (single use).

current_password.description: The password in use: required when `email` changes.

email.description:
The new email address (unverified until the mailed link is
followed). Changing it requires `current_password`.

User.description:
A user as `/api/v1/users` returns it:
`{__type: "User", id, name, email, email_verified_at, roles, created_at}`.

email_verified_at.description: When the email address was verified, if it was.

email.description: The email address (trimmed; stored lower-cased; unique).

UserPage.description:
The OpenAPI shape of `GET /api/v1/users` (a `Page<UserView>`):
`{data: User[], meta}`.

data.description: The users on this page, by name.

UserResource.description:
The API representation of a [`User`]:
`{"__type": "User", "id", "name", "email", "email_verified_at", "created_at"}`,
plus the fields of the registered [`UserResourceExtension`]s when built
with [`AuthService::present`](crate::AuthService::present).

email_verified_at.description: When the email address was verified, if it was.

UserUpdateInput.description: The body of `PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}`: only the fields present change.

oneOf.description: The CRM role (replaces the user's roles).

bearer.description: A JWT access token from `POST /api/auth/login` or `/api/auth/refresh`: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
